resources.string: Justnoise Gate 0 uses Android Accessibility only while you have explicitly enabled this prototype. It observes window-change events and reads the foreground package identifier so it can compare that identifier with the one app you selected. It does not read screen content, typed text, passwords, notifications, or accessibility nodes. Foreground event contents are not retained or sent anywhere. The selected app, consent version, enforcement state, and a keyed Zap digest stay only on this device. You can withdraw below, disable the service in Accessibility settings, Force Stop, or uninstall at any time.
I understand this disclosure and choose to test the Accessibility capability.
